name: Fiendish Arms

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: Your devilish features develop, mutating your body. You gain a hoof unarmed attack that deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage and a horn unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Both attacks are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits, and the hoof also has the agile trait. Strikes with these unarmed attacks gain the sanctified trait. You also gain the Invoke Infernal Flames action.
